notes: soundLAB grows a second workspace: the Studio. Tap the Studio button in the header and a screen wipe slides you over to the songwriting side — same key, same tempo, same everything. First tools: a capture button (the red dot in the top bar, on EVERY page) records whatever you play — ROLI, typing keys, touch piano — into your song's Ideas, tagged with key and tempo; retro-capture keeps the take you played BEFORE you hit record (last 30 seconds, always remembered); ideas play back on a new expressive synth ported from the OpenStudio DAW (full ROLI slide/pressure support, more of it coming). This is phase one of the full DAW — sections, lyrics, tracks and mixing land next.
